summary: 3D Systems filed an 8-K on 2026-11-05 disclosing entry into a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald as sales agent for an at-the-market program of up to $42.5 million of common stock under its Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-296180, effective 2026-05-27). Sales may occur at prevailing market prices or in negotiated/block transactions; Cantor receives up to 3.0% commission. The company is not obligated to sell and may suspend at any time; either party may terminate on ten business days' notice. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any overhang from actual sales.
